scope: Norwood-specific annual licenses, permits and registrations; benchmarks optional only when directly comparable

series.measure: Active driver licenses held by Norwood residents
series.caution: Municipal resident counts need source verification

series.measure: Fishing licenses held by Norwood residents by year
series.caution: Do not use statewide totals or point-of-sale location as residence

series.measure: Hunting and sporting licenses held by Norwood residents by year
series.caution: Combined sporting licenses require consistent counting

series.measure: Active LTC and FID, plus applications by status and year
series.caution: Separate applications, licenses issued, and active license inventory

series.measure: Active licenses by class and year
series.caution: Avoid conflating renewals, transfers, and total active licenses

series.measure: Dealer, victualer, taxi, lodging, entertainment and other licenses
series.caution: Separate permits issued during year from active license stock

series.measure: Dogs licensed per calendar year; new versus renewal if available
series.caution: Active registrations and annual issuances are distinct

series.agency: Norwood Town Clerk / Massachusetts Registry of Vital Records and Statistics
series.measure: Marriage intentions or licenses issued in Norwood per year
series.caution: Marriage intention filed in Norwood does not necessarily mean couple resides in Norwood; prioritize Norwood resident counts where available

series.measure: Building permits issued by year and category, permit valuation and residential units authorized
series.caution: Permits and dwelling units are different measures; alterations not new construction

series.agency: Norwood Town Clerk and Licensing Board
series.measure: Annual business certificates, license and permit issuance by category
series.caution: Business certificates are not counts of operating establishments
